description:
Transcribe voice notes and calls on-device
Anti-Vocale transcribes voice messages from WhatsApp, Telegram, and other messaging apps directly on your Android device. All processing happens on-device: your audio never leaves your phone. It works on recorded calls and meetings too: recordings of any length are split and stitched automatically (up to two hours on the streaming path), a failed run keeps the transcript it produced, and long transcripts can be exported as subtitles (SRT, VTT) or timestamped text, with sentence-level timing on streaming models.

BUILT-IN MODELS

- Parakeet TDT (recommended): fast, 25 European languages. Two variants: high-quality (862MB) or compact (640MB)
- Whisper Turbo: 99 languages, balanced speed and quality
- Whisper Distil Italian: best Italian quality, tuned for voice messages
- Whisper Medium / Small: more accuracy or smaller download
- Nemotron 3.5 streaming: text appears in real time while it decodes, 45 languages
- Qwen3-ASR: compact, 59 languages
- GigaAM v3: Russian, very small and fast
- Gemma 4 / 3n (LiteRT): multimodal AI with customizable prompts

BRING YOUR OWN MODELS

Import custom transcription models from a folder on your phone or from a link: Whisper fine-tunes, CTC models, SenseVoice and other sherpa-onnx architectures. Files are integrity-checked on import, split-file models are supported, and every imported model gets its own share target. Ideal for languages the built-in models don't cover.

FEATURES

- Personal dictionary: list the names and terms you care about and the models that support biasing (Parakeet, GigaAM, streaming Nemotron, Qwen3) steer their decoding toward them; a strength slider tunes how aggressive the correction is
- Ask AI: with a Gemma model installed, ask questions about your saved transcripts and get answers on-device, grounded in your own history
- Summary presets: recaps shaped as plain summaries, action items, or meeting minutes, or your own custom prompt
- Model cards state how each model's memory footprint fits your phone's RAM tier, so big downloads are an informed choice
- Share voice messages from any app via the Android share sheet
- Smart notifications: one-tap copy, share back, page through long transcripts without opening the app
- Auto-copy to clipboard and auto-save transcripts to a folder you pick (Drive, Syncthing, ...)
- Video file transcription (audio track extracted)
- Real-time progressive text with streaming models
- Per-app notification preferences
- Transcription log with search and swipe actions
- In-row audio playback: replay a recent transcription's audio right from its history row, with speed control and an optional skip-silences mode
- Silence stripping and parallel chunk processing for speed
- Neural acceleration (NNAPI) on supported devices, with automatic CPU fallback
- Tasker integration for automation
- Scheduled folder watch: transcribe new audio files in folders you choose automatically (on Android 11+, even a messaging app's media folder)
- Remote offload (experimental, off by default): delegate long transcriptions to your own OpenAI-compatible server
- WhatsApp voice notes transcribe themselves: new voice notes in WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business become transcripts as they arrive, zero taps, with the sender's name when it can be confirmed
- Built for aggressive battery savers: an opt-in background protection keeps transcription running with the screen off (Realme, Oppo, OnePlus, Vivo and similar), and the app recovers on its own from crashes and corrupted models
- Open Transcribe provider (experimental): apps that speak the open contract, like Forkgram, turn Anti-Vocale into their inline voice transcriber

PRIVACY

No network needed after download, no accounts, no data collection, no ads, no tracking. By default the audio never leaves your phone; the only exception is the optional Remote offload feature, which sends audio solely to the server address you configure and stays off unless you turn it on.

OPEN SOURCE

Apache 2.0. Source code: https://github.com/Ris
